field_principles.arxiv_rows: Primary paper rows preserve canonical identity, time, and title.
field_principles.candidate_rows: A closed disposition prevents a lead from silently becoming work.
field_principles.claim_boundary_rows: Each item states what its source cannot prove for Carnot.
field_principles.deduplication_rows: Canonical suppression stops rediscovery from appearing novel.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured duration distinguishes an executed audit from a template.
field_principles.execution_venue: The venue separates host work from unavailable hardware claims.
field_principles.extropic_rows: Vendor projections remain separate from attached-hardware evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: One principle per field makes the scientific contract reviewable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact diagnostics make blocked or invalid work actionable.
field_principles.github_rows: Repository identity does not prove method quality or Carnot fitness.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix gives automation one unambiguous outcome.
field_principles.huggingface_papers_rows: Generated summaries remain discovery signals below primary papers.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate limits this result to a bounded network source audit.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The compute class confirms that the audit loads no model.
field_principles.logical_intelligence_rows: Kona stays a comparator without public reproducibility.
field_principles.openreview_rows: A browser challenge stays an access receipt, not an inferred claim.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Explicit gates prevent unavailable sources from becoming fabricated results.
field_principles.primary_source_receipts: Each candidate traces to a paper or official project page.
field_principles.query_rows: Exact queries disclose coverage without treating rank as evidence.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed records deterministic ordering without sampling.
field_principles.references_append_hash: The hash records the exact ledger after any bounded append.
field_principles.references_append_path: The path makes the only permitted documentation write explicit.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A payload hash detects evidence or verdict changes.
field_principles.rows: A combined ledger supports independent collection consistency checks.
field_principles.run_date: A fixed execution date prevents future sources from entering this receipt.
field_principles.search_window: Fixed source and observation windows make freshness claims falsifiable.
field_principles.semantic_scholar_rows: Rate limits and citation indexes cannot become scientific authority.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the result to the local evidence that was read.
field_principles.source_class_rows: Each requested source class ends with an honest receipt.
field_principles.v624_sota_ingestion_complete_score: One means coverage and promotion rules passed.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class keeps outages and invalid rows from reading positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that a source audit cannot certify Carnot correctness.
